checkin.userExplain: The organizer requires you to check in for this event. Tap the button during the check-in window to confirm you are available. If you do not, you may be moved to the waitlist.
checkin.userSquadProgress: {done} of {total} of your team have checked in.
paymentRules.label: Per-country payment
paymentRules.infoTip: Optional. Set, per country, whether teams or players from that country pay the entry fee or join for free, and optionally charge a different amount. A squad uses its team country; a solo player uses their own country. This does not change the private-event invite link, which is still required regardless of country.
paymentRules.helpText: Leave empty to charge every country the base entry fee.
